# FG-DB-0003

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 500 |
| 重大度 | alert |
| Runbook | [`db-migration`](../../ops/runbooks/db-migration.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `a_failing_migration_is_migration_failed_and_leaves_no_partial_version` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: データベースの更新に失敗しました。管理者に連絡してください。
- en: The database upgrade failed. Contact the administrator.
- id: Pembaruan basis data gagal. Hubungi administrator.

## 原因 (cause)

forge db migrate could not apply a migration: its SQL failed (the transaction was rolled back, so the version is not recorded), another migration run held the lock past database.lock_timeout_ms, or the migration files could not be read.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event carries `version` (the failing migration, when known), `reason` (sql_failed, locked, source, driver) and for SQL errors `sqlstate` / `db_message` (data-free states only). `forge db status` shows what is applied and pending; nothing is half-applied because each migration runs in one transaction.

## 対処 (fix)

Fix the migration in a new release (an applied migration is never edited — ADR-0014), or wait for the other run (locked) and retry `forge db migrate`.
